This weekend I finished up an 800 gallon fish tank for an aquaponic greenhouse I'm working on. I've never fiberglassed anything in my life but it turned out pretty good
I've always wanted to try messing with fiberglass. Any tips, anything you would do a different way in hindsight?

Lol, to be 100% honest in hindsight I would just use a liner. But for tips on the fiberglass, I would say that I definitely regret underestimating the scope of the project. I welded a frame and stuck some plywood and plexiglass in it. Easy. Then, I planned to use 8 pounds of a conventional epoxy paint, a few sheets of fiberglass for just the corners and then coat everything with a 1.5 qt non-toxic epoxy kit. Nope. I ended up using 32 pounds of the conventional epoxy instead. It was ridiculous, the wood and fiberglass seemed to just suck up the paint. Also, I wouldn't buy an epoxy that is mixed based on weight instead of volume. Weighing it was a pain in the ass. Overall I ended up with a good product but it took many many weekends to complete
